Free previews Marvel Magic announces on Home while they run (Scott 11/14: 'if anyone is running free previews we want to announce that when it happens'). One entry each: title, note, start/end (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive), for = the service a viewer must have to get it (null = anyone), url = where to watch, svc = the app Watch opens. Claude adds entries as they are announced.
